t: 特拉扬继承了养父内尔瓦为罗马皇帝.
te: Trajan succeeds his adoptive father Nerva as Roman emperor.
dz: 特拉扬继承了养父内尔瓦为罗马皇帝.
de: Trajan succeeds his adoptive father Nerva as Roman emperor.

t: 在内尔瓦逝世后,特拉扬被科隆封为罗马皇帝,这是他政府位于下德意志的所在地.
te: On the death of Nerva, Trajan is declared Roman emperor in Cologne, the seat of his government in lower Germany.
dz: 在内尔瓦逝世后,特拉扬被科隆封为罗马皇帝,这是他政府位于下德意志的所在地.
de: On the death of Nerva, Trajan is declared Roman emperor in Cologne, the seat of his government in lower Germany.
